requirements.text: The mobile app must offer features that ensure compliance with regulatory requirements to avoid risks.
The app should provide real-time updates and account control features for users, such as monitoring transactions.
Customers should receive alerts for account activity and gain insights into their spending.
Any additional features, such as budgeting tools or financial goal-setting, must be evaluated for compliance before implementation.
New features must be compatible with existing systems and not create compliance issues during integration.
